client.business_model: Nationwide network of mobile and in-shop service centers that provide preventative maintenance and repair for medium- and heavy-duty commercial truck and trailer fleets
client.sponsor_pe_firm: Ares Management Corporation (majority stake acquired April 2025)
client.client_history: Founded in 2016 and headquartered in Nashville, Tennessee, Epika Fleet Services has grown rapidly through a series of acquisitions into a coast-to-coast platform serving more than 2,000 fleet customers across almost 40 states.

revenue.notes: No official revenue disclosed. LeadIQ estimates USD 25-50 M. Mid-point (37.5 M) shown as placeholder; actual could be anywhere in the cited range.

locations.source: Pr Newswire press release 2025-04-21 (cites ~20 in-shop centers)
locations.notes: Press release states 'approximately 20 in-shop centers'; mobile service branches not counted as physical locations.

employees.notes: Multiple sources cluster between 500 and 1,000 employees, with 550 identified as technicians alone. Using 700 as mid-point of overlapping ranges.
